# Leaving Cert — Wyatt's Notes

> Free, open-access study notes. Part of the Wyatt's Notes network at https://wyattsnotes.wyattau.com

Leaving Cert revision notes covering core subjects with detailed explanations, worked examples, practice problems, and flashcards.

All pages are open-access, ad-free, and licensed under AGPLv3.

## Overview

- [About This Site](https://leaving-cert.wyattau.com/about/): About Wyatt's Notes Leaving Certificate resources, experience, expertise, and credentials behind the Irish Leaving Cert study materials.

- [Irish Leaving Certificate](https://leaving-cert.wyattau.com/intro/): The (Leaving Cert or LC) is the final examination of the Irish Secondary school system, administered by the (SEC). It is taken by students aged 16 to 19
- [Irish Leaving Certificate Glossary, Key Terms](https://leaving-cert.wyattau.com/glossary/): Comprehensive glossary of Irish Leaving Certificate terms covering the examination system, grading, CAO points, subjects, and university admissions.
